asr.full_text: Welcome to Mirror Trading International. Growing your Bitcoin and your MTI account. The objective of Mirror Trading international is to grow your Bitcoin. Bitcoin is the currency and all trading is done using Bitcoin. It is never converted to another currency. One Bitcoin equals 100 million Satoshi. 1 Bitcoin equals 1 million Bits Your Back Office is always displayed in bitcoinbits Trading takes place from Monday to Friday Please remember that historical results are not an indication of future results. Albert Einstein referred to compound interest as the 8th wonder of the world. Each day the trading profit is added to your trading account so that you automatically get the benefit of compound interest. With Mirror Trading International your Bitcoin is growing daily. Therefore when the price of Bitcoin rises you will have the added benefit from having more Bitcoin. You can add more Bitcoin to your MTI account at any time. Withdrawals take up to 48 hours, and you can withdraw any amount. There are no fees for withdrawals. Further information on adding Bitcoin to your MTI account, or making a withdrawal, can be found on other videos for more information please contact the person who sent you this video
